text: NO EFFECT: At baseline, late endosomal/lysosomal pH did not differ between isogenic APOE44 and APOE33 iMG (both ~5.15) (reported: no difference (both ~5.15)).
description: Isogenic APOE33/APOE44 KOLF2.1J (male) human iPSC-derived microglia, untreated. Ratiometric ApHID/Alexa647 70 kDa dextran LE/Ly pH imaging calibrated in fixed cells. n=3 wells, 9 frames per well; one-way ANOVA. Caveat: microglia, not astrocytes; late endosome/lysosome compartment rather than early endosomes.

provenance.excerpt: While baseline LE/Ly pH did not differ between APOE33 and APOE44 iMG (~5.15), APOE33 iMG exhibited further acidification upon challenge (~5.05), whereas APOE44 iMG failed to do so (Figure 3G).

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> no change in baseline late endosomal/lysosomal pH in iPSC-derived microglia [NO EFFECT]

warnings: effect size 'no difference (both ~5.15)' has no accepted form: recorded as qualitative, numbers kept in description

perturbed.variable: APOE44 vs APOE33 genotype (isogenic KOLF2.1J iPSC-derived microglia), unchallenged

measured.variable: Baseline late endosomal/lysosomal luminal pH (ratiometric ApHID dextran)
